question: Every year 'ease of doing business index' is released. It is released by:
solution:
Correct answer is __**World Bank Group.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **'ease of doing business index'** was published by **the World Bank Group** every year from** 2003 to 2019** and focused to calculate the costs to firms of business regulations in 190 countries.
 
• The World Bank Group works with **developing countries to reduce poverty and increase shared prosperity.**
 
• The main motive of both the **World Bank and IMF **were to help **European and Asian countries** needing financing to fund post-war reconstruction efforts.
 
• Both the World Bank and IMF outlasted the collective international monetary structure which was** central to the Bretton Woods Agreement.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8227e7252dcd75584471dc65fa2558e1dd89d0b9dc5bbea1c3d6eca628bb693.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The IMF's main aim is **to ensure the stability of the international monetary system.**
 
• ​The World Economic Forum is **the International Organization for Public-Private Cooperation**.
 
• Harvard Business School is **one of the largest business schools in the world**, and this comes with a number of chances.
